'''Hard energy particles''' were particles that were fired by [[Bola carbine/Legends|bola carbines]]. The particles formed an [[Stun net/Legends|energy net]] that could stun opponents for a brief time.<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
